notes: Cats: United States carries the whole American subject in the Régionale bank (61 stems, 16 of them North Coast) and California the Village bank (40 stems, 21 of them North Coast); both are shared with the Central Coast, and United States with New York and the Pacific Northwest too. The North Coast stems that sit under Producers & Icons, History & Figures, Sparkling Wine World and Classifications & Labels are cited in the review, not mapped, since those categories carry the whole world. Chapters: the Régionale chapter calnorth and the Village chapter California. Region: napa-sonoma, which holds every AVA the Court names in Napa and Sonoma, with Mendocino and Lake County as its places, and the producer list. Country: california for the label percentages, Estate Bottled, Meritage, Reserve and the Paris cards. Grapes: the seven the Court names, all profiled. Techniques: maritime-fog for the bay and the Petaluma Gap, oak and malolactic for the Court's winemaking cell, traditional-method for the Carneros and Anderson Valley sparkling wine. Service table: decanting, whose rows name young Napa Cabernet and the old red off its sediment, the Court's service cell.
